title: The Allure of the Wall Cabinet: Irish Elm, Mahogany, and French Walnut
summary: Stevan Hartung views furniture as an experiential art form, emphasizing how materials, textures, shadows, and user interaction contribute to an object’s character and longevity. He is particularly…
description: Stevan Hartung views furniture as an experiential art form, emphasizing how materials, textures, shadows, and user interaction contribute to an object’s character and longevity. He is particularly drawn to wall cabinets because their intimate scale, craftsmanship, and hidden interiors create a unique balance between visual composition, function, and discovery.
